author: Calciferous
body:
Hey! My name is Granulation! I have changed it recently though. I have been Reconfigured since September. I'm saying this just to clear things up about my activity.

Age: 14 y/o
Timezone: Eastern Standard Time (-5)
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No

Section 1
Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? No, I have never been a staff on any major servers. Only on servers of friends
What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
Strength: I have a keen eye for seeing when people are saying things in chat and I am usually one of the first to see the message. I also am good at picking up if someone is hacking or if they are just plain good. This will affect my moderating because I can get the bad people off of the server and make it a better environment for people who want to just have fun and play fair.
Weakness: I may come off as a little harsh to some people, but I try not to let that get in my way. I like to be as nice as I can be in a situation. I'm not super harsh though. I also like to make jokes but some people take them the wrong way.
How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
I think I can improve the Staff Team because I sometimes play with my friend and he constantly says that the Staff Team is lazy. I want to make my friend more happy about the Staff Team and make the bans more fair. I think the reason mods tend to ban people on the other team more than their own is not because of bias, but because they don't see that they are hacking because of Friendly Fire. My friend will know that in time. I also think that I can handle reports better. I sometimes find that people are reporting a person like crazy and the mods won't come on the server. I will always come on the server if I am being spammed with reports. Even if I get one report, I will come on the server and inspect the person that is being accused.
What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
I think that a leader needs to be independent and determined to lead. A leader also can't be really biased towards a certain person or group of people. I also think that a leader shouldn't be too controlling. I see players mini-modding sometimes and they are getting hate on it. I used to mini-mod when I was younger, but I stopped when I found out how annoying that is. That is the definition of being too controlling. I am controlling in a way when it comes to my OCD, but I learned that it is incredibly annoying to be really controlling and so I stopped. Sometimes, I consider myself a leader. Sometimes, I'm just not in the mood to lead, but other times, I am. Often times I find myself in a group where I am forced to be the leader. I usually do good, unless I am in a situation where I have no idea on what I am doing.
What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
Some moderators don't reply to single reports that players give. I think that I can distinguish from the other players because I will look at every report if I already know that that person is not hacking. This server is a small server, so I know a lot of people on it. I will be able to tell who I should go and check on. If I don't recognize the name, I will go see what's going on over there. I also like to engage in the games rather than go there one second and leave the next. I want to play the game and talk to the fellow players. I also think I have a good sense of humour, so I enjoy making jokes and seeing people type in the chat: "xD" or "lol" or something else along those lines. I'm not "that guy" who everyone hates and never cracks a joke. I like to engage.
What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
I think that people should have a good sense of humour when interacting with the community because people will like you and you will be reliable to talk to when someone needs help of some sort. Also, it's nice to be serious when someone is breaking the rules of the server. I am pretty active on the server and I constantly see rule-breakers and I want to get rid of those bad people. I also think that someone should also respond to reports and deal with problems. I think I have the humour, like I mentioned in the last question. I love to make people laugh. It's one of the best feelings. I also have the seriousness for rule-breakers. Those people are incredibly annoying, especially when I just want to play Minecraft and have a good time on Avicus. Finally for the reports, I will be able to respond to all of the ones that aren't stupid where it's against people that I have talked to and are just simply really good at PvP.
How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
I will be able to commit around an average of 3 hours a day. On weekends, I can commit more like an average of 5. I love minecraft.

Section 2
You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
I would ban his ip. If that isn't allowed, I would just ban all of his accounts. The ban evaders are so committed that they will spend $100+ on alternate accounts and guess what, I don't care!! I ban all of them! 
Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?
I would go on myself and ask them to leave. If they don't, I would send a report to an admin and they can deal with the harassing staff member. They can remove his permissions and get him demoted and/or banned.
A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?
I would ask them to get evidence that isn't corrupt and if they don't, I would have to tell them sorry. They broke the rules and unless I have physical proof there for me to see, they aren't getting their punishment revoked. They will have to consult with another staff member or give me proof.
You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
I would ask him why he exposed the file to other people that aren't part of the staff team. I would certainly feel betrayed, but I wouldn't tell the admins on him because it wasn't important. Who even cares that much anyways?
One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?
I would consult with a Senior Staff about the decision and hopefully get that decision revoked. If I can't, I would simply have to adapt to the new decision and not bring it up. It takes me a while to adapt to change, especially big change, but I will get used to it.

Section 3
What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
It would make me so happy because it would be a new experience to me to play on a real server that isn't just run by a friend who has a server. I want to get the experience of actually getting to help govern a server and it would feel nice, and also boost my own self esteem, mainly because of the fact that I sometimes feel worthless. This would help because it means that the Senior Staff Team actually decided to pick me to become a moderator and be a part of the staff.
How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
Avicus is one of my favourite servers. Whenever I'm bored, I join Avicus and play some DtM. I also have some friends that I introduced to the server. Most of them don't play it anymore, but one friend I Skype all the time plays it. It's funny when he gets mad at the hackers. There is this one player he despises and whenever he is on, he screams his head off whenever he kills him. I'm not going to say the name of the player, my friend hates. My friend is NoahTheDevil. He got banned once for hacking, even though he was just lagging. He has a really bad computer with really bad internet, so don't hate on him for getting banned. I was there skyping him when he got banned.
Do you speak any other languages than English?
I am learning Spanish, but I'm really basic in it. I know about a hundred Spanish words and that's about it. English is my first language and I am very precise in it.
Do you have anything else to add to your application?
I have been playing since the server was still called MCZone. I started playing about 3 and a half years ago. I have a lot of experience. The server is really great and I love it. It remains in my top 2 favourite servers. I can't decide between Avicus and another server I am not going to mention. My name is Colin by the way. Thank you for reading, Granulation.
